messages.subject: adjust geom_text
parts:
Hello,

I have some problems with a plot (see attachment)

1) How do I produce greek letters (with a * after the letter - like µ*) with geom_text?

2) The thing below the red line (I will call it the ALPHA TERM): I would prefer an alpha (greek letter with * after the letter) exactly positioned at the y-axis. It should belong to the legend.

3) How can I reduce the decimal places if I use geom_text?

4) I would like to move the label ("rs...") (see LABEL TERM) slightly to the right. Of course automatically.

Thanks
Hermann

ny <- ggplot (df) +
    geom_point ( aes (x=pos, y=logpval, colour = factor (modd))) + scale_colour_brewer(palette="Set1")+
 
      geom_text (data=dfa, aes (x = 100, y = a-0.2 , label = n, hjust =0, vjust=0.2, size =3))+ # this my ALPHA TERM that does not satisfy me
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = hu, labels = zu)+
        ylim (yd,yh)+
  ylab ("-log10 pval") + xlab ("Chromosomes")+
    ggtitle (title)+
  geom_hline (yintercept = lb, colour = "red")+
       geom_text (data = subset (df, pval < bonp), aes ( x=pos, y=logpval, label =snpid, hjust=0, vjust=0.5))+ #LABEL TERM
    theme_bw()+
      theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())+
        theme (legend.position = "none")

messages.subject: Re: adjust geom_text
parts:
plotmath handling is a bit inconsistent in ggplot, for the title you need to use the standard expression/substitute/bquote business, e.g.

var=3.14
p + ggtitle(bquote("some text "*alpha == .(var)))


HTH,

b.
